title: Serene Cottage by Foodie Spots
description:
Chic cozy guest house in the center of Nashville's new foodie oasis in McFerrin Park! Soak in the west coast vibes with polished concrete floors, fully stocked kitchen, dedicated workspace, familiy amenities like pack n play, and a plush queen bed for the sleep of dreams! Walking distance to Folk, Sean Brock's Audrey, and his newest, June, Wilbur Street Tavern, Red Headed Stranger, and more!

*9 mins drive from Broadway, Music City Center, Nissan Stadium, and Bridgestone Arena! 12 mins to Opry

The space
The entire guest cottage and parking area!

Guest access
Guests have use of the entire guest cottage, parking area, and outdoor pergola seating area!

Other things to note
We have a Ring doorbell camera for security.

*We highly recommend purchasing travel insurance as there are no exceptions made to our cancellation policy.
